manifest.hypothesis: Do dependency-certified agent branches avoid lost updates and phantoms while merging more concurrent work than serial execution?
manifest.metrics: lost updates; undetected phantoms; certified merge rate; conflict rate; merge latency
manifest.baseline: serial execution; last-writer-wins branches; key-level optimistic locking without range digests
manifest.falsification: Any lost update or undetected phantom is a hard failure; no throughput gain over serial execution at conflict rates below 10% rejects the default.
